items.html: And it is found that this Hesed of Atik, within the Keter, called pure air, brought out from it the spirit that is hidden in Atik Yomin, which is the Yod that went out from the air and light remained. And this Yod is Aba, the Yod of the holy name, which at first was hidden in Atik in this Hesed. And therefore when this Yod went out from this air, and the aspect of Aba was made from it, it did not go out but clothed the Hesed of AA; and then in this Aba this air is hidden, meaning that it shines in it in the manner of concealment and hiding from above to there.
